verdict.rationale: The only versioning signal in the evidence is the /v1/ prefix on the Identity endpoint (api.stripe.com/v1/identity/verification_sessions), which shows a versioned API path but nothing more. No document in the pack describes a versioning scheme, how versions are pinned or upgraded, or any deprecation policy. Missing for 10: documented API versioning scheme (pinning, upgrade path, changelog), documented deprecation policy or timelines, any independent corroboration.
